name: Princess Must Die!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
narrative.objectives: Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, adventurer.

Now, do either of these suit you?
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you see her yet? Did you get her?
